description:
workout_session.note is read by the sessions route and the recap screen, and written by nothing. A column that is readable but never writable looks finished when it is not, which RULES 5 calls worse than not having the field.

Add a "finish workout" action at the end of a session that writes the note. It also gives the session an explicit end, which pairs with T-010's derived duration and gives the recap screen something to be the destination of.
title: Finish a workout with a note
